Unity Bank is new-age, digital-first banking that is efficient, easy and ready 24X7 for every banking need. Headquartered in Mumbai, Unity Small Finance Bank is an RBI-licensed Scheduled Commercial Bank that commenced operations on November 1, 2021.
Unity Bank is promoted by Centrum Financial Services Limited and Resilient Innovations Private Limited (BharatPe), as a joint investor.
We offer a suite of services and features, including Savings, Current and NRI Accounts, Fixed and Recurring Deposits, Micro-loans, MSME loans, Digital lending, Supply Chain Finance, and Insurance solutions, that are designed to give you smart, simple and superior banking experience.
The bank currently has a national footprint of over 170 plus branches pan India.
